long_video.label: Long-form video script
long_video.goal: Create a complete retention-focused long-form YouTube script.
long_video.format: Hook, promise, structured sections, transitions, payoff, and call to action.
constraints: Write spoken narration, not production commentary.
Use pattern interrupts and open loops without clickbait deception.
Make the structure easy to record and edit.

short.label: YouTube Short script
short.goal: Create a fast vertical-video script designed for retention.
short.format: Immediate hook, compact value, payoff, and short CTA.
constraints: Keep every sentence recordable.
Avoid introductions and filler.
Target roughly 20-60 seconds unless the user specifies otherwise.

title.label: Video titles
title.goal: Produce strong, accurate YouTube title options.
title.format: A ranked list of title options with a short rationale for the top three.
constraints: Prioritize clarity, curiosity, and truthful specificity.
Avoid misleading clickbait.

description.label: Video description
description.goal: Write a searchable YouTube description that supports the video.
description.format: Opening summary, value points, CTA, chapters placeholders when appropriate, and hashtags.
constraints: Use natural keywords.
Do not invent links or claims.

tags.label: Tags and keywords
tags.goal: Create a focused YouTube keyword set.
tags.format: Primary keywords, secondary keywords, long-tail phrases, and tags.
constraints: Prefer relevance over quantity.

thumbnail.label: Thumbnail brief and image prompt
thumbnail.goal: Design a high-clarity thumbnail concept and production prompt.
thumbnail.format: Concept, focal subject, composition, text overlay options, visual contrast, image-generation prompt, and negative prompt.
constraints: The thumbnail must communicate one idea at small size.
Use minimal text.
Do not generate the image itself.

community_post.label: Community post
community_post.goal: Create a YouTube community post that starts conversation.
community_post.format: Post copy plus an optional poll or question.
constraints: Sound human and concise.

short.label: TikTok script
short.goal: Create a native TikTok vertical-video script.
short.format: Scroll-stopping first line, concise beat-by-beat script, payoff, and CTA.
constraints: Start with the result, tension, or surprise.
Use conversational language.
Avoid filler.

caption.label: TikTok caption
caption.goal: Write a caption that complements rather than repeats the video.
caption.format: Caption, CTA, and a small set of relevant hashtags.
constraints: Keep it natural and platform-native.

hook.label: TikTok hooks
hook.goal: Generate varied first-second hooks for the topic.
hook.format: Ranked hook options grouped by angle.
constraints: Each hook must be immediately understandable.

series.label: TikTok series plan
series.goal: Turn the topic into a repeatable TikTok series.
series.format: Series promise, episode list, recurring format, and publishing sequence.
constraints: Each episode must stand alone while encouraging the next view.

live_outline.label: TikTok LIVE outline
live_outline.goal: Plan a structured TikTok LIVE session.
live_outline.format: Opening, segments, interaction prompts, offers or CTA, and close.
constraints: Include audience interaction throughout.

thumbnail.label: TikTok cover brief
thumbnail.goal: Create a readable vertical cover concept.
thumbnail.format: Cover text, frame choice, composition, and image prompt.
constraints: Keep text readable in the profile grid.
Do not generate the image itself.

reel.label: Instagram Reel script
reel.format: Hook, visual or spoken beats, payoff, CTA, and on-screen text suggestions.
constraints: Keep the spoken copy natural.
Make the first frame understandable without sound.

carousel.label: Instagram carousel
carousel.goal: Create a swipeable educational or persuasive carousel.
carousel.format: Cover slide, one idea per slide, summary, and CTA.
constraints: Use concise slide copy.
Create a clear narrative across slides.

post.label: Instagram feed post
post.goal: Write a complete feed post around the topic.
post.format: Opening line, body, CTA, and relevant hashtags.
constraints: Use readable paragraph spacing.

story.label: Instagram Story sequence
story.format: Frame-by-frame copy, suggested visual, and interaction sticker.
constraints: Each frame should be quickly understandable.

caption.label: Instagram caption
caption.goal: Write a caption with a strong opening and natural CTA.
caption.format: Hook, value or story, CTA, and hashtags.
constraints: Avoid generic motivational filler.

bio.label: Instagram bio
bio.format: Three differentiated bio options with name-field and CTA suggestions.
constraints: Communicate who it is for, value, and next action.

thumbnail.label: Reel cover brief
thumbnail.goal: Create a clear Reel cover concept.
thumbnail.format: Cover text, composition, subject, style, image prompt, and negative prompt.
constraints: Optimize for profile-grid readability.
Do not generate the image itself.

post.label: Facebook post
post.goal: Write a Facebook post that encourages reading and discussion.
post.format: Opening, useful or emotional body, question or CTA.
constraints: Use natural language and readable spacing.

long_post.label: Long Facebook post
long_post.goal: Create a longer narrative or educational Facebook post.
long_post.format: Strong opening, structured body, takeaway, and CTA.
constraints: Maintain momentum across longer paragraphs.

reel.label: Facebook Reel script
reel.goal: Create a short vertical-video script for Facebook Reels.
reel.format: Hook, concise script beats, payoff, and CTA.
constraints: Make the value clear immediately.

story.label: Facebook Story sequence
constraints: Keep each frame simple.

group_post.label: Facebook group post
group_post.format: Context, useful contribution or question, and discussion prompt.
constraints: Avoid sounding promotional unless requested.

ad.label: Facebook ad copy
ad.goal: Draft ethical direct-response Facebook ad copy.
ad.format: Primary text options, headline options, description, and CTA suggestions.
constraints: Do not invent proof, guarantees, or customer claims.

thumbnail.label: Video thumbnail brief
thumbnail.goal: Create a Facebook video thumbnail concept.
thumbnail.format: Concept, text overlay, composition, image prompt, and negative prompt.
constraints: Optimize for clarity on mobile.
Do not generate the image itself.

post.label: X post
post.goal: Write a concise standalone X post.
post.format: One polished post plus two alternative angles.
constraints: Make every word earn its place.
Do not add hashtags unless useful.

thread.label: X thread
thread.goal: Create a structured thread that rewards continued reading.
thread.format: Strong first post, numbered sequence, final takeaway, and CTA.
constraints: Each post should work as an individual unit.
Avoid repeating the same point.

reply.label: X reply
reply.format: Primary reply plus a shorter alternative.
constraints: Be direct and non-generic.

poll.label: X poll
poll.format: Poll question, answer choices, and follow-up post.
constraints: Choices must be distinct and fit the platform.

space_outline.label: X Space outline
space_outline.format: Title, promise, opening, segments, speaker questions, audience Q&A, and close.
constraints: Build in interaction and time guidance.

video_script.label: X video script
video_script.goal: Create a concise native-video script for X.
video_script.format: Hook, script, visual beats, and CTA.
constraints: Lead with the claim or insight.

thumbnail.label: Video cover brief
thumbnail.goal: Create a video cover or card concept for X.
thumbnail.format: Concept, headline, composition, and image prompt.
constraints: Do not generate the image itself.

post.label: LinkedIn post
post.goal: Write a credible LinkedIn post that delivers a useful professional insight.
post.format: Opening, context or story, insight, practical takeaway, and conversation CTA.
constraints: Avoid fake vulnerability and corporate clichés.
Use short readable paragraphs.

article.label: LinkedIn article
article.goal: Create a substantive long-form LinkedIn article.
article.format: Title, introduction, structured sections, examples, conclusion, and CTA.
constraints: Prioritize useful depth over inflated length.

carousel.label: LinkedIn document carousel
carousel.format: Cover, slide-by-slide copy, summary, and CTA.
constraints: One main idea per slide.
Keep slide copy concise.

newsletter.label: LinkedIn newsletter
newsletter.format: Subject/title, opening, sections, practical takeaway, and next-edition tease.
constraints: Provide standalone value.

video_script.label: LinkedIn video script
video_script.goal: Create a credible professional video script.
video_script.format: Hook, concise argument or lesson, example, takeaway, and CTA.
constraints: Sound spoken, not like an essay.

poll.label: LinkedIn poll
poll.format: Question, answer choices, framing post, and follow-up discussion prompt.
constraints: Avoid obvious or leading choices.

thumbnail.label: Video or article cover brief
thumbnail.goal: Create a clean professional cover concept.
thumbnail.format: Headline, composition, visual style, image prompt, and negative prompt.
constraints: Keep the design credible and readable.
Do not generate the image itself.
